278177812.description:
Vintage Dalby, Stanwell Grown 5 Briar & Medico Vario Tobacco Pipes Set
This listing includes three vintage tobacco smoking pipes from different brands and styles. The first pipe is a Dalby made from carved briar wood featuring a straight black stem; it shows noticeable use and char inside the bowl. The second pipe is a Danish Stanwell Grown 5 Briar with a bent shape, natural wood grain finish, and a black stem marked 'Danish' and 'Stanwell'. The third pipe is a Medico Vario, constructed from briar wood with a metal band and a bent stem, displaying significant wear and use. All pipes are used, with darkening and residue inside the bowls and some wear on the stems. These pipes are suitable for collectors or restoration purposes.
